source: Swift AI Academy MVP product document (mvp_prd_doc), demo catalogue
source_note: Prototype-authored curricula. Hours are notional; credits and NSQF level are still to be confirmed in the source document.

tracks.name: Applied AI/ML Practitioner
tracks.blurb: Build, test and evaluate applied machine learning solutions on real tabular data.

tracks.name: Business Data Analyst
tracks.blurb: Turn spreadsheets and databases into dashboards and decisions.

tracks.name: Workplace Communication Pro
tracks.blurb: Speak, write and interview with clarity for associate roles across IT services and BFSI.

courses.title: Python for data work
courses.overview: Get comfortable writing Python to load, clean and summarise tabular data.
outcomes: Write and run basic Python programs
Load and clean a tabular dataset

courses.title: Data handling and statistics
courses.overview: Learn to describe and question a dataset before modelling it.

courses.title: Machine learning foundations
courses.overview: Frame a problem, train a simple model, and evaluate it honestly.

courses.title: Applied ML project
courses.overview: Run an end-to-end applied ML project and present it for review.

courses.title: Spreadsheets to SQL
courses.overview: Move from spreadsheet formulas to SQL queries on the same problems.

courses.title: Dashboards and visual reporting
courses.overview: Design a small dashboard that actually helps someone decide something.
outcomes: Choose the right chart for a question

courses.title: Analytics case studies
courses.overview: Practice the full analyst loop: question, plan, evidence, recommendation.

courses.title: Spoken clarity and listening
courses.overview: Practice speaking and listening clearly under everyday workplace pressure.

courses.title: Written workplace English
courses.overview: Write emails and updates that get read and acted on.
outcomes: Write a status update with a next action

courses.title: Interviews and group discussion
courses.overview: Prepare evidence-based interview answers and practice group discussion.
outcomes: Contribute constructively in a group discussion

courses.title: Make It Stick
courses.overview: Produce a tested, repeatable AI-assisted method for a recurring task and demonstrate its use.
outcomes: Build a documented, reusable AI-assisted method
Test the method on an awkward input and diagnose faults
Demonstrate and commit to using the method going forward
courses.weeks: Weeks 12–15 of a wider semester series

Documentation.gap: Written English covers emails, not forms, logs and record keeping.

Customer handling.gap: Spoken clarity helps, but there is no customer service, voice process or CRM module.

Problem solving.gap: Case studies build analytical problem solving, not shop-floor troubleshooting.

Data annotation.gap: Data quality is taught inside AI02, which assumes some coding. There is no no-code annotation course for Class 12 or ITI learners.

skill_map_note: Which Swift AI Academy course teaches each skill named in local job ads. full = the course teaches it; partial = related but a module is missing; none = no course yet. Curated by the research team; review when the catalogue changes.
trade_skills_note: Hands-on trade skills taught at ITIs and through Sector Skill Council courses. Swift AI Academy does not plan to teach these; the platform refers learners to ITI, NSTI or SSC courses instead.
